lines: Start in Projects. Choose New project, then Blank project.
Give it a name, add a cover, pick the production type, and create it.
Your project page keeps the cover and production details together.
Next, open Templates, pick the call sheet, and use the template.
Fill it in. It saves as you go, with a live preview of the PDF.
Then save it to your project.
The call sheet is now in the project, under Behind the Production.
Last, add your references. Drop in stills, briefs or voice memos, and each is tagged as it uploads.
